go_rebuilt: go build -a with an empty GOCACHE: every package, the standard library and third-party modules included

third_party_context.note: Go's std-primed cold build compiles its 31 third-party package(s) from source, while Flint links its native libraries and platform archives prebuilt; the deps-primed ratio is the like-for-like comparison.

No deps-primed equivalent exists: go build -a recompiles every package, the third-party ones included, while Flint's --no-platform-cache rebuilds the D modules but links the native C libraries prebuilt.
